- 01KWMYW8HA1TGCXRWNB26JD1EN: "Migration verify uses subset-containment (source ⊆ target) rather than set equality"
- 01KWMYW8KA6NRARJDAWB3WCD2K: "No legacy-v1/ full backup in the 1.x migrate"
